rows.label: curl -I http://[ip]
rows.value: HTTP banner grab — returns response headers including Server

rows.label: curl -Ik https://[ip]:[port]
rows.value: HTTPS banner grab — -k ignores certificate errors

rows.label: nc -nv [ip] [port]
rows.value: Netcat banner grab — connects and reads raw response (SSH, FTP, SMTP)

rows.label: nc -nv -w 3 [ip] [port]
rows.value: Netcat with 3-second timeout for services that wait for input first

rows.label: -sV
rows.value: Service version detection — probe-based behavioural fingerprinting

rows.label: --version-intensity 0
rows.value: Minimal probing — fastest, least accurate

rows.label: --version-intensity 5
rows.value: Default intensity — balanced speed and accuracy

rows.label: --version-intensity 9
rows.value: Maximum probing — slowest, most thorough. Use on unusual or non-standard ports.

rows.label: -sS -sV
rows.value: Combine SYN port scan with version detection in one pass

rows.label: -sV -p [ports]
rows.value: Run version detection on specific ports only — faster than full host scan

rows.label: -oA [filename]
rows.value: Save all output formats — always use for engagement documentation

rows.label: Step 1: Quick check
rows.value: curl -Ik https://[ip]:[port] — immediate banner read for web services

rows.label: Step 2: SSH banner
rows.value: nc -nv [ip] 22 — reads SSH banner automatically on connect

rows.label: Step 3: Full -sV sweep
rows.value: nmap -sV -T4 -oA service-[ip] [ip] — systematic version detection

rows.label: Step 4: Difficult services
rows.value: nmap -sV --version-intensity 9 -p [port] [ip] — maximum probing

rows.label: Step 5: CVE research
rows.value: nvd.nist.gov — search with software name and version string

rows.label: PORT STATE SERVICE VERSION
rows.value: The four columns in -sV output

rows.label: OpenSSH 7.4 (protocol 2.0)
rows.value: Software: OpenSSH. Version: 7.4. SSH protocol version: 2.0

rows.label: Apache httpd 2.4.49 ((Unix))

rows.label: Apache Tomcat 7.0.37
rows.value: Software: Apache Tomcat. Version: 7.0.37

rows.label: ssl/http [software]
rows.value: HTTP service over SSL/TLS — HTTPS

rows.label: filtered [no version]
rows.value: Port filtered — version detection probe blocked. Version unknown.

rows.label: B — Banner
rows.value: Read what the service announces. Record the exact string.

rows.label: V — Version
rows.value: Confirm the version through -sV. This is the intelligence that enables CVE research.

rows.label: R — Research
rows.value: Search nvd.nist.gov for known vulnerabilities affecting this exact version.
